claims: As of April 2026, Justin Bieber is headlining the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival on April 11 and April 18, 2026.
Coachella Weekend 1 is on April 11, 2026 in Indio, CA.
Coachella Weekend 2 is on April 18, 2026 in Indio, CA.
As of April 12, 2026, there is no official confirmation of Justin Bieber's full 2026 tour, according to reports.
Reports previously suggested a potential 10-12 show North American stadium tour by Justin Bieber was being planned following his Coachella headlining sets.
Justin Bieber had not toured since early 2022 before his 2026 Coachella dates.
Justin Bieber canceled dates in early 2022 due to health issues.
